checks.name: api.01.fixture-and-readiness
checks.expected: Protected local fixture and pins intact; ready app exposes an independent loopback fixture; data outside source.

checks.name: api.02.existing-draft-workflow
checks.expected: Fixture tickets, ordered persistent draft creation, retrieval and editing work.

checks.name: api.03.invalid-input-atomicity
checks.expected: Invalid bodies, JSON and admission IDs fail without partially mutating messages/outbox.

checks.name: api.04.durable-admission
checks.expected: Queued immutable envelope and exactly one outbox row commit before admission returns; no transmission yet.

checks.name: api.05.admission-idempotency
checks.expected: Concurrent exact admission retries coalesce; request IDs bind one message; conflicting admissions return 409.

checks.name: api.06.accepted-delivery
checks.expected: Explicit drain commits matching provider receipt and durable attempt count; repeat drain has no new effect.

checks.name: api.07.rejection-and-bounded-pass
checks.expected: Rejected attempt becomes retryable with error; one drain makes at most one attempt per eligible message.

checks.name: api.08.retry-stable-envelope
checks.expected: Explicit retry after transient failure retains key/body and succeeds once; terminal retry rejected.

checks.name: api.09.lost-accepted-response
checks.expected: Lost response after provider acceptance remains unresolved; stable-key retry reconciles one existing receipt.

checks.name: api.10.queued-cancellation
checks.expected: Cancelling queued work prevents transmission; cancellation persists and is idempotent; retry rejected.

checks.name: api.11.inflight-preaccept-cancellation
checks.expected: Provider cancellation tombstone resolves held preaccept send; late completion cannot resurrect it.

checks.name: api.12.acceptance-wins-cancellation
checks.expected: Committed receipt wins a cancellation race and survives a later lost send response.

checks.name: api.13.concurrent-drains
checks.expected: Overlapping drains cannot duplicate logical delivery, provider effect or durable outbox membership.

checks.name: api.14.restart-after-admission
checks.expected: Queued work, body, key and outbox survive hard restart without premature transmission.

checks.name: api.15.restart-before-acceptance
checks.expected: A hard stop in held preaccept work is recoverable with the original key and one eventual receipt.

checks.name: api.16.restart-after-acceptance
checks.expected: Provider receipt survives hard app stop; next drain reconciles the same accepted effect without duplication.

checks.name: api.17.terminal-history-durable
checks.expected: Delivered/cancelled history, attempts and receipts persist; terminal operations cannot mutate envelope or resend.

checks.name: api.18.ticket-and-queue-isolation
checks.expected: Multiple-ticket replies retain independent outcomes and ordered, duplicate-free durable history.

checks.name: browser.01.browse-compose-edit
checks.expected: Accessible ticket navigation, saved draft and editing work through visible controls.

checks.name: browser.02.validation-preserves-input
checks.expected: Invalid save has a visible useful error and retains entered text without creating a message.

checks.name: browser.03.queue-is-truthful
checks.expected: Queue action shows queued status, no receipt/delivered claim and no editable admitted body.

checks.name: browser.04.delivery-details
checks.expected: Process queue shows accepted state, real receipt, message identity and attempt details after refresh.

checks.name: browser.05.retry-workflow
checks.expected: Provider failure is visible with Retry; explicit retry uses same key and converges to receipt.

checks.name: browser.06.preaccept-cancel-workflow
checks.expected: Cancel before provider acceptance visibly settles cancelled, with no provider receipt/effect.

checks.name: browser.07.too-late-cancel-workflow
checks.expected: Unknown send is not shown delivered; too-late cancellation shows actual receipt and useful explanation.

checks.name: browser.08.narrow-restart-workflow
checks.expected: At 390px, queue/details controls are reachable and committed work survives app restart and page refresh.
